reason: The stepped podium and detached heart remain distinct symbols. The heart floats above the highest platform as the subject of the ranking, rather than a physical podium feature.

components.name: Three level podium
components.description: A stepped podium has a tall central platform and shorter side platforms, all with flat tops and straight vertical edges. Exclude the heart.

components.name: Broad heart
components.description: A broad heart has two rounded upper lobes meeting at a central notch and tapering into a lower point. Exclude the podium.
